      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'Build system' label and primarily modifies CMake configurations across src/CMakeLists.txt and src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Creates dedicated internal kernel and kernel-utility CMake library targets to formalize internal module boundaries and prevent duplicate source lists. The author notes this completes the internal library design in doc/design/libraries.md and enforces allowed boundaries via check-deps.sh."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to doc/design/libraries.md merely document the library structure introduced by the CMake changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not docs: a code change that also updates its docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Separates the internal kernel static library and isolates kernel utility dependencies away from libbitcoin_util.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Directly advances the kernel boundary by separating utility dependencies so the kernel only compiles against required utilities. Removing node and extraneous utility dependencies from kernel builds constitutes core architectural work for libbitcoinkernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "No test framework or test harness files are changed.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR contains no test infrastructure modifications."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates to contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh follow directly from the build system dependency additions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A mechanical edit to dependency enforcement scripts that follows from build target reorganization is treated as build, not tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only modifies src/util/CMakeLists.txt to split target definitions without changing utility source code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR changes CMake library definitions rather than utility code or primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt by two lines to link against the new internal kernel library target.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "A mechanical build target dependency update following from changes elsewhere does not make the PR a wallet member."
